title: Flow diagram
description: One to three cards on the left flow into a gold hub in the middle and out to one to four cards on the right. Every curved line draws itself and a small dot rides its tip once (Web Animations API for the cards and lines, a plain function of time for the dots; no library). The diagram fills the slide; on a phone it runs from top to bottom along a trunk on the left.

props.hub: required, the middle: {title, text} or 1-3 words
props.to: required, 1-4 results on the right: {title, text} or strings
props.from: 1-3 inputs on the left: {title, text} or strings
props.title: heading, 3-8 words
